# Expanding All Loottables, Ultimate Edition.

## Post 6260 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-08T09:40:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6260#p6260 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**Disclaimer:** These items were NOT confirmed to be added YET. Look at them with a grain of salt.
So, I decided upon writing these separate from the custom quests post to stop cluttering it like hell. Also, it's to help me put these all together, unseparated from the talking in that post. **Few Extra Details:** Items were designed so the lower level the dungeon, the less rare items it has to follow the pattern of how current boss loot works. It also has more polearms and fist weapons so we can see more of those. **Update:**N ew loot for the Gurubashi Arena Chest, lots of new world drops and even Elemental Invasions! Update 2: Even if I am not writing them here new items are being trickled here, check often if interested.  **Special Thanks** to **Sinrek** and **Balake** for helping me balance these items and **Sylph** and **Paulgreeneye** for the item ideas! Well, that's it. I present to you,

 **Expanding All Loot tables, Ultimate Edition**

## Post 6272 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-08T09:52:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6272#p6272 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**World Drops**

[Pendant of Kindred Spirit](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a hunter only necklace that increases the power and endurance of your animal companion.

[Pendant of Eternal Servitute](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a warlock only necklace that strenghtens the binds of your enslaved demon to this plane, giving them more power in this plane.

[Basic Guide to Necromancy](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), it's so easy to understand you can easily raise your own skeleton! The skeleton is level 25 with no abilities. The book has a 30 minute cooldown.

[Sharpsight Eyepatch](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), who knew aiming with one eye would increase your sharpshooting? Missile weapons mean bows, guns and crossbows if you didn't understand.

[Robe of Divinity](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), especially good for priests or holy paladins.

[Attuned Shoulders](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a pair of shoulders that's specialised in arcane power, fitting for arcane mages and balance druids.

[Overseer's Ring](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=1189/overseers-ring), a pretty low level ring.

[Rugged Boots](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5968/rugged-boots), low level boots.

[Mark of the Kirin Tor](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5004/mark-of-the-kirin-tor), a pretty nice caster necklace. Could drop from [Dalaran Summoners](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=2358/dalaran-summoner) around Dalaran.

[Huge Ogre Sword](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=913/huge-ogre-sword), a nice two handed sword. Could drop from the [Splinterfist Ogres](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=889/splinter-fist-ogre) in Duskwood.

[Dusty Chain Armor](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=2016/dusty-chain-armor), just some mail chestplate.

[Inscribed Gold Ring](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5010/inscribed-gold-ring), a pretty nice melee dps/tank ring.

[Quicksilver Ring](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5008/quicksilver-ring), a good rogue/hunter ring.

[Gemstone Dagger](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5742/gemstone-dagger), a pretty interesting dagger.

[Fairy's Embrace](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7549/fairys-embrace), a fairly well known scrapped ring, making a return!

[Serpent Clasp Belt](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12258/serpent-clasp-belt), a fairly powerful belt.

[Savage Mail Tunic](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12615/savage-mail-tunic)
[Savage Mail Shoulders](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12617/savage-mail-shoulders)
[Savage Mail Boots](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12616/savage-mail-boots)
 **The Savage Mail Set** has strenght and stamina on mail on an high level, a good replacement for those enchantement shamans that wear the Scarlet Mail set until level 60.

[Bladebane Armguards](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=14550/bladebane-armguards), the single scrapped world epic I found, it's pretty nifty. Really good stats for any DPS that would wear it.

[Charged Servo Arm](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), the misplaced servo hammer is misplaced no more! World drop from Gnomeregan.

[Spreadshot Shotgun](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a gun that has a chance to do shoot 3 enemies at once, it's a shotgun you know.

[Wand of Divine Justice](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a wand to support Smite Priests! World drop from Scarlet Monastery.

[Frostshatter Bulwark](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a shield that has a chance to freeze the attacker and increases your critical chance by %20 aganist frozen targets. Go shatter some ghouls!

[Dualcaster Wand](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a wand that both does frost and fire damage and increases your spellpower for them too.

[Cowl of Terror](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a mid level cowl mainly designed for ****Warlock Tanks****. Pun intended.

[Goblin Mail Hauberk](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Goblin Mail Boots](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
can drop from the [Goblin Shipbuilders](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=3947/goblin-shipbuilder) and [Goblin Craftmans](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=1731/goblin-craftsman) in the Deadmines.

[Arcane Core](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) can drop from [Arcane Nullifier X-21](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=6232/arcane-nullifier-x-21) in Gnomeregan.

[Silithid Egg](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), an one use item that hatches a small Silithid Harvester to help you for 2 minutes. Drops from [Silithid Harvester](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=3253/silithid-harvester), a rare mob in The Barrens.

[Prismatic Crystal](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) is a trinket that summons a random Earth/Water/Fire/Air Elemental with different abilities. Not gonna spoil it, it's very fun.

[Healing Ward](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Spider's Bite](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Duskreaver](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Bloodhowler](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Gift of the Spider God](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Extra Arena Chest Loot

[Arena Sash](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Arena Cord](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Arena Belt](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Arena Girdle](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Those bracers looked a little lonely in the Gurubashi Arena Chest so I made them some friends, within the same gear style of course.
